heading: All remaining T_wcet parameters are compile-time constants
text:
### All remaining T_wcet parameters are compile-time constants [LDTL.7.2]

After substituting `max_expired_per_tick` for `expired_max`, every
parameter in the T_wcet formula is a compile-time constant:

| Parameter | Source |
|---|---|
| `n_ttl_schemas` | DSC schema count — fixed at load |
| `max_expired_per_tick` | Derived ([LDTL.7.1]) |
| `F_max` | The compiler's activation-chain bound — a rule-topology constant |
| `A_max` | The most actions in one rule — a DSC constant |
| `E_rhs` | The deepest RHS expression — a DSC constant |
| `α_s` | Schema selectivity — data-dependent but N_max-bounded |
| `T_s` | Alpha test count per node — DSC constant |

None of these grow with N_max beyond what is already captured in
`max_expired_per_tick` and `α_s` (both of which are bounded by
`N_max` but divided by a deployment-chosen denominator).

Viewed as a function of N_max (the variable the integrator controls),
the T_wcet formula is **O(1) in N_max** under `linear_scan: false` with
default TTL.  The formula computes a fixed number; it does not express
a growth rate.
